opennyai_summary.final__facts:
The instant application for anticipatory bail has been filed by the petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with Phulparas P.S. Case no. 262 of 2022 instituted for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 354, 379, 494, 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per allegation in the FIR, it is a case of matrimonial dispute between the petitioner and informant.
Allegedly, petitioner had performed second marriage with another lady.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
Petitioner had never tortured his wife nor demanded any thing from her.
5. Learned APP appearing for the State has opposed the prayer of Bail.
opennyai_summary.decision:
6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case as stated above, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
The petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within a period of four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender in connection with Phulparas P.S. Case no. 262 of 2022, he will be enlarged on bail on Dev Sharma @ Dev Kumar Sharma vs The State Of Bihar on 5 March, 2025
